Original Calzone
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, February 26, 2010 - 11:33pm

Ingredients




1 pound Dough for Italian bread
1/2 pound Ground beef
1 small Onion, chopped fine
1 teaspoon Parsley chopped fine
1 8oz can tomato sauce
1/2 cup Grated romano or parmesan cheese
1/4 cup Mozzarella cheese, shredded
1/4 cup Provolone cheese, shredded salt and 
Preparation

1 Mix ground beef with salt, pepper, onion, parsley, and grated cheese. 2 Fry off until meat turns brown. After meat cools, mix in mozzarella and provolone cheese and tomato sauce. Roll out dough in approximately 6 inch circle. Put in 1/3 cup of meat mixture and fold over like a apple turnover.
